'''Esa Parna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as a member of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]], Esa Parna was employed as an agent of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Intelligence Service|Intelligence Service]] during the government's early years. As part of her job, Parna served undercover as Liaison officer [[Lon Kinnik]]'s chief aide during his assignment on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Serving the liaison delegation to the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], she reported back to her superiors at NRI all information of interest. Stationed at [[High Port Space Center]], Parna served her position dutifully during her tenure at the agency.<ref name="GATORW" />
